cards.example_en: We talk about our weekend in class.
cards.example_zh: 我们在课上谈论周末。

cards.example_en: I need to talk to the librarian.
cards.example_zh: 我需要和图书管理员讲话。

cards.example_en: She likes to talk with her neighbours.
cards.example_zh: 她喜欢和邻居交谈。

cards.example_en: Think about the question before you answer.
cards.example_zh: 回答前先考虑这个问题。

cards.example_en: Teachers think highly of honest work.
cards.example_zh: 老师高度评价诚实的作业。

cards.example_en: I cannot think of his name.
cards.example_zh: 我想不起他的名字。

cards.example_en: Think over the offer tonight.
cards.example_zh: 今晚仔细考虑这个提议。

cards.example_en: Please turn down the music.
cards.example_zh: 请把音乐调低。

cards.example_en: Water can turn into ice.
cards.example_zh: 水能变成冰。

cards.example_en: The rumour did not turn out to be true.
cards.example_zh: 谣言结果不是真的。

cards.example_en: You can turn to your teacher for help.
cards.example_zh: 你可以向老师求助。

cards.example_en: He did not turn up until noon.
cards.example_zh: 他直到中午才出现。

cards.example_en: Do not use up the hot water.
cards.example_zh: 不要把热水耗尽。

cards.example_en: Wait for me at the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 在校门口等我。

cards.example_en: Students wait on guests at the open day.
cards.example_zh: 开放日学生们侍候来宾。

cards.example_en: Guides warn hikers about the cliff.
cards.example_zh: 向导提醒徒步者注意悬崖。

cards.example_en: Doctors warn against skipping breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 医生告诫不要不吃早餐。

cards.example_en: Cheap shoes may wear out in a month.
cards.example_zh: 便宜的鞋可能一个月就磨破。

cards.example_en: One wrong click can wipe out a file.
cards.example_zh: 点错一次就可能彻底清除一个文件。

cards.example_en: Let us work out the total together.
cards.example_zh: 我们一起把总数算出来吧。

cards.example_en: Do not worry about a single rank.
cards.example_zh: 不要担忧一次排名。

cards.example_en: Write down the formula before you forget it.
cards.example_zh: 在忘掉之前把公式写下来。

cards.example_en: I write to my cousin once a month.
cards.example_zh: 我每个月给表弟写一封信。

cards.example_en: Do not yield to the urge to guess.
cards.example_zh: 不要向瞎猜的冲动让步。

cards.example_en: They will finish the report at all costs.
cards.example_zh: 他们将不惜一切代价写完报告。

cards.example_en: At first sight the map looks simple.
cards.example_zh: 乍一看，这张地图很简单。

cards.example_en: Keep a pencil at hand during the quiz.
cards.example_zh: 测验时把铅笔放在手边。

cards.example_en: She explained the chart at length.
cards.example_zh: 她详尽地解释了这张图。

cards.example_en: The teacher calls names at random.
cards.example_zh: 老师随机地点名。

cards.example_en: He won the game at the cost of a late night.
cards.example_zh: 他以熬夜为代价赢了比赛。

cards.example_en: The small boat is at the mercy of the wind.
cards.example_zh: 小船任由风摆布。

cards.example_en: She spoke at the risk of being wrong.
cards.example_zh: 她冒着说错的风险开了口。

cards.example_en: The crowd noise was beyond control.
cards.example_zh: 人群的喧闹无法控制。

cards.example_en: The sunrise was beyond description.
cards.example_zh: 日出的景象难以形容。

cards.example_en: I met my old friend by accident.
cards.example_zh: 我偶然遇到了老朋友。

cards.example_en: By chance, the shop was still open.
cards.example_zh: 碰巧商店还开着。

cards.example_en: They talk by means of a video call.
cards.example_zh: 他们凭借视频通话交谈。

cards.example_en: The task is by no means easy.
cards.example_zh: 这项任务决不容易。

cards.example_en: She entered by virtue of her high score.
cards.example_zh: 她凭借高分入选。

cards.example_en: The room is quiet except for a clock.
cards.example_zh: 房间很安静，除了一只钟以外。

cards.example_en: He whispered for fear of waking the baby.
cards.example_zh: 他小声说话，生怕吵醒宝宝。

cards.example_en: She stayed for the sake of the team.
cards.example_zh: 她为了队伍的缘故留下来。

cards.example_en: Choose one book from among these three.
cards.example_zh: 从这三本当中选一本书。

cards.example_en: A note fell from between the pages.
cards.example_zh: 一张纸条从书页之间掉出来。

cards.example_en: The cat came from under the desk.
cards.example_zh: 猫从书桌底下出来。

cards.example_en: In a sense, the loss was a lesson.
cards.example_zh: 在某种意义上，这次失利是一课。

cards.example_en: Please buy the ticket in advance.
cards.example_zh: 请事先买票。
